summary: @GracePigozzi #lra18 To be fair the tech, and more importantly bandwidth wasn't there for awhile, conferences book 5-6 years out. Hotels used to (and still) jack you for wifi. We did experiment. One year the e-editors ran around recording sessions for YouTube.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @GracePigozzi #lra18 To be fair the tech, and more importantly bandwidth wasn't there for awhile, conferences book 5-6 years out. Hotels used to (and still) jack you for wifi. We did experiment. One year the e-editors ran around recording sessions for YouTube.
